<!-- markdownlint-disable-file MD041 -->
## Change and purpose

Describe what changes, why it is needed, and any compatibility impact.
Link related issues where applicable.

## Destination

Confirm the target branch using
[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/qualcomm-linux/meta-qcom/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).
Identify any dependent, upstream, or backport changes.

## Validation

Record the exact checks or commands performed and their results, such as the
kas builds and the CI-equivalent checks. Explain anything not checked.

## Documentation and review

- [ ] I reviewed the change and updated affected documentation and folder indexes.
- [ ] Function comments, the configuration reference, and tutorials match any implementation changes.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass; exceptions or unresolved dependencies are explained above.
- [ ] Every commit follows the commit message and sign-off rules in CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] The change and its evidence contain no credentials or confidential data.

Mark inapplicable items with a reason. Use the private route in
[SECURITY.md](https://github.com/qualcomm-linux/meta-qcom/blob/master/SECURITY.md)
for vulnerability details.
